subject: PO constraints: weekly invoice split & carryforward credits
messages:
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@cleartrail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: PO constraints and invoice cadence

Hi Jonas,

We're moving forward on the pilot and Procurement has a couple of operational constraints we need confirmed before issuing a blanket PO:

- We prefer weekly invoicing (individual invoices for week-ending) instead of a single monthly invoice because of our ledger reconciliation.
- Credits/discounts from overage or shortfall need to be carry-forwardable for up to two subsequent billing periods (we can't expire them within the month).
- PO header must include: company entity (ClearTrail Logistics LLC), legal tax id, the Redwood contract ID (if provided), a specific PO number format (CT-YYYY-#####), and a service description matching SOW line items.
- Net terms requested are Net45.

Can Redwood accept weekly invoices and bake in a carryforward credit mechanism? Also, if there are discount thresholds that depend on invoice cadence or consolidation, please outline them so we can align internally.

I'll attach our PO template for your reference (attached). If any of this requires an amendment to the draft MSA, say so and we'll surface it to Legal.

Thanks,
Clara Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearTrail Logistics
Attachments: ClearTrail_PO_Template_v3.pdf (1 page; PO field map)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@cleartrail.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO constraints and invoice cadence

Hi Clara — thanks for the details and the template. Quick answers up front and a few clarifying Qs so Finance can validate.

Short answers:
- Weekly invoices: yes, we can emit weekly invoices (separate invoice per week-ending) and map them to your PO number.
- Carryforward credits: we support credit carryforward, but the mechanics depend on whether this is a preapproved commitment or a post-hoc reconciliation. Finance (cc'ed Priya) can confirm limits.
- Net terms: Net45 is generally OK for approved enterprise customers; Priya please confirm any sign-off or risk review needed.

Clarifying questions:
1) Is the carryforward intended for volume/price credits only, or also for tax/fee adjustments?
2) Do you require a consolidated monthly statement in addition to weekly invoices (some AP teams prefer a monthly roll-up for payment runs)?
3) Is CT-YYYY-##### mandatory on every invoice line? If yes, we'll add validation to our billing pipeline.

Vanessa — can you weigh in on discount bands? My initial thought: we can offer a 5% volume discount if annualized committed spend > $250k and invoices are consolidated monthly; if you need weekly invoices and retain carryforward credits, the discount table needs to be adjusted (smaller % or tied to committed prepayment).

I'll attach our PO guidance to highlight the exact fields we require on the Redwood side.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference.com>
To: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@cleartrail.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 09 Jun 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO constraints and invoice cadence

Hi Clara / Jonas,

Finance notes below — thanks for raising the template. High level: we can support the workflow but need to set a few policy guardrails.

Policy items:
- Weekly invoices: acceptable. We'll push invoices into our AR system tagged to your PO number; payments will apply per-invoice in arrival order.
- Carryforward credits: supported only for pricing/usage credits (not tax/withholding). Credits can be carried forward up to 60 days from issuance (matches your Net45 request and gives an extra 15-day buffer for processing).
- Discount mechanics:
  - Volume discounts tied to annual committed spend: we can offer 3% at $150k+, 5% at $350k+, subject to a quarterly reconciliation.
  - If you require weekly invoices and want the carryforward feature without a pre-funded commitment, discount levels are reduced by 1 percentage point across tiers (to reflect increased AR complexity).
- PO fields required on every invoice: PO number (CT-YYYY-#####), billing entity, GL code if provided (optional but helpful), service description matching SOW line item, and the contract ID (Redwood-XXXX).

Operational asks from your AP team:
1) Provide an example weekly invoice run (sample CSV or PDF) so we can test the parser.
2) Confirm AP contact and the expected payment cutoff day each month.

If you're happy with the carryforward 60-day window and the adjusted discount tiers, we can accept Net45 and weekly invoices. Otherwise we can propose a middle ground: consolidated monthly statement for payment with weekly invoice detail for reconciliation (this preserves higher discount tiers).

Priya Natarajan
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments referenced: Redwood_PO_Template_Guidance.pdf (1 page)
From: Clara Nguyen <clara.nguyen@cleartrail.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.inference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.inference.com>, ClearTrail AP <ap@cleartrail.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO constraints and invoice cadence

Thanks — that all helps. A few follow-ups and confirmation from our side: 

- We can accept the 60-day carryforward window; that meets our internal controls.
- Regarding discounts: ClearTrail can commit to an annualized spend target of $320k for the pilot year. We'd like a 4% volume discount tied to that band, with quarterly reconciliation. We acknowledge the 1% haircut if weekly invoices are used without pre-funding; however, given our AR cadence, we prefer weekly invoices. Can you confirm final discount: 3% (if Redwood enforces the weekly-invoice haircut) or 4% (if Redwood can keep the higher band despite weekly cadence)?
- AP will provide a sample weekly invoice CSV (attached) and our preferred payment cutoff is the 15th of each month for prior-period invoices.

Attached: ClearTrail_sample_weekly_invoice.csv (sample), ClearTrail_PO_Template_v3.pdf (original).

If you can confirm the final discount and the PO mapping rules (CT-YYYY-##### on each invoice line), we'll issue the blanket PO next week and route to Legal if any MSA amendment is required.

Best,
Clara Nguyen
Senior Procurement Manager
ClearTrail Logistics
